Toronto Parking Authority aspires to make Bike Share Toronto the premiere bike sharing system in the world. 2023.PA5.3.t: Policy Overview:  Discounted Parking for Canadian Veterans
2023.PA5.3.s:
Toronto Parking Authority Board of Directors has been requested by City Council to report on the feasibility of providing parking discounts to Canadian Veterans.

Toronto Parking Authority currently has a targeted program that provides free parking to Canadian Veterans at all Toronto Parking Authority off-street parking facilities located on lands owned by the City of Toronto. This program supports Canadian Veterans on four (4) commemorative days each year and applies to all vehicles that display a valid Ontario Veteran’s license plate (Poppy Plate). In addition, Toronto Parking Authority also provides free localised parking in coordination with the Royal Canadian Legion in support of events honouring or commemorating a significant military event that may occur from time to time throughout the city.

Toronto Parking Authority’s current parking payment systems do not have the capability to identify eligible customers or to process discounts across on-street and off-street parking environments. Given the significant costs associated with the replacement of Toronto Parking Authority’s current parking payment systems, the development of an extended parking discount program to Veterans is not recommended at this time.

2023.PA7.10.t: Temporary Closure of Car Park 89 (20 Eaton Avenue)
2023.PA7.10.s:
As a part of the Ontario Line project, Metrolinx has identified Car Park 89, located at 20 Eaton Avenue, as a preferred location to stage the construction of the Pape Interchange Station (the "Project"). A number of other City-owned properties, including 743 Pape Avenue and 25 Lipton Avenue, have also been identified as being required to support the Project.

Car Park 89 has been identified by Metrolinx as the most suitable location to stage the Project given that Pape Station will be partially demolished and rebuilt within the future Pape Interchange Station and the subway tunnel will be constructed through City lands. Metrolinx has therefore requested the use of the Toronto Parking Authority lands through the City’s Real Estate Protocol for the Province of Ontario’s Priority Transit Projects, which includes the Ontario Line.

To facilitate the temporary closure of Car Park 89, Metrolinx is proposing to enter into a licence agreement with the City for exclusive use of the 59-space lot at 20 Eaton Avenue (Refer to Attachment 1 – Site Location Map). The licence agreement is for a term of five (5) years, with one (1) option to extend the term for up to four (4) additional years. Metrolinx has indicated it requires the entire lot as of January 2024.

The President of Toronto Parking Authority recommends that:

1.
